investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (250 files) was observed for user Tomas.Kazlauskas@globalcorp.ee, well above the 24-hour baseline of 20 files. The activity originated from Vilnius, Lithuania, occurred during local business hours, used Office 365 SharePoint Online, and involves internal documents related to logistics and procurement, which aligns with the user's role. With a clean source IP reputation and no recent similar alerts, the evidence suggests this is more likely legitimate business activity rather than an immediate exfiltration tactic, though the spike should be monitored.
